Technical Skills

Engineering Stack: Strong hands-on proficiency in Python and/or .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core), Java, or Node.js.
AI & GenAI: Practical experience with GenAI APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG patterns, or agentic workflow frameworks.
Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCPmicroservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
Automation: Exposure to workflow orchestration engines, RPA tools, or custom automation scripts.
Enterprise Platforms: Familiarity with enterprise systems (Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or ServiceNow) is a plus.
Certifications: Cloud Certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP) at associate/developer level is a plus.



Soft Skills

Clear technical communicationable to explain code implementation to teammates and project managers.
Collaborative team player accustomed to working across global/offshore time zones.
Curious and self-motivated proactively explores new AI tools, frameworks, and engineering patterns.



Experience

Experience: 5–8 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with 3+ years as, Senior AI engineer

Hands-on experience building and delivering enterprise-grade solutions across cloud, AI/ML, and application engineering.

Experience working in client-facing delivery environments within IT services or consulting organizations is preferred.



Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-on Engineering & Delivery

Write production-grade code to build component-level features and API integrations based on technical designs and blueprints.
Actively contribute to daily engineering deliverables—developing backend microservices, driving unit testing, refactoring code, and resolving technical debt.
Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality, performance, maintainability, and adherence to team engineering standards.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex bugs, API integration issues, and performance bottlenecks within application microservices.



AI & Engineering Framework Adoption

Learn, implement, and integrate for AI-native feature— including GenAI integration patterns, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation
Contribute to the development and maintenance of AI engineering frameworks, solution accelerators, and reusable technical assets.

Evaluate and experiment with new tools, APIs, and platforms in the AI and cloud-native space.



Technical Consulting & Problem Solving

Engage with client technical teams to understand system landscapes, integration requirements, and technical constraints.

Propose pragmatic, technology-forward solutions to complex engineering challenges across application modernization, AI integration, and cloud migration.

Support the Solution and Principal Architect in pre-sales activities including technical assessments, proof-of-concept design, and effort estimation.



Cloud & Automation Execution

Develop and deploy cloud-native services on AWS, Azure, or GCP using containers (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless functions, and event-driven patterns.
Implement intelligent automation components using workflow orchestration engines, RPA integrations, or custom AI-driven pipelines.



Engineering Community & Mentoring

Mentor junior engineers—supporting technical upskilling on AI tools, cloud platforms, and modern engineering practices.

Contribute to Jade's internal community of practice through knowledge sharing, documentation, and participation in architecture discussions.



Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field is required.

Job Summary

The Software Engineer - Expert or Lead Consultant is a hands-on senior individual contributor who architects, builds, and operates complex digital products across AI, agentic systems, semantic technologies, data engineering, and cloud platforms. The role provides cross-product technical leadership, guides engineering teams, resolves critical technical challenges, and owns production performance and measurable product outcomes.

Responsibilities
Serve as a recognised expert across business domains and technology stacks, sharing standards and reusable practices across the organisation.
Align cross-product technical strategy with product managers, architects, engineering peers, and key stakeholders.
Shape product architecture and design, balancing scalability, security, resilience, performance, operability, cost, and delivery speed.
Lead discovery, scoping, inception, and iteration planning, translating product outcomes into system designs, technical backlogs, and delivery plans.
Direct complex, business-critical engineering initiatives spanning teams, products, sites, or platforms.
Remain hands-on by building critical components, validating designs, reviewing code, and resolving complex technical issues.
Architect AI-enabled and data-intensive products, including agentic AI, LLM services, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, and data pipelines.
Establish CI/CD, automated quality gates, secure engineering practices, and reliable release automation.
Own production readiness and operational excellence across reliability, observability, security, performance, incident response, and product KPIs.
Act as the team's technical anchor, guiding technology choices, resolving conflicts, and addressing cross-team risks and dependencies.
Coach engineers in paired programming, test-driven development, secure coding, and knowledge sharing across the engineering community.
Required Skills Qualifications
10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex, production-grade products or platforms.
Expertise in software architecture, distributed and cloud-native system design, hands-on development, automated testing, CI/CD, security, observability, and production operations.
Strong programming capability in Python and at least one additional modern language, with the ability to guide implementation and resolve complex issues at code level.
Proven experience architecting and delivering LLM-based and agentic AI systems, including model and agent evaluation, MLOps/LLMOps, AI observability, and responsible AI controls.
Strong knowledge of semantic technologies, including RDF, OWL, enterprise ontologies, knowledge graphs, SPARQL, semantic alignment, and ontology mapping.
Experience with data engineering and analytics patterns, including ETL/ELT, lakehouse architecture, dimensional modelling, metadata-driven pipelines, and enterprise data models.
Experience delivering AI and data solutions on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric, or comparable enterprise cloud platforms.
Demonstrated ability to lead architecture decisions across teams and products, mentor experienced engineers, establish standards, and influence product, engineering, data, security, and business stakeholders.
Experience owning production outcomes and using reliability, customer, and business KPIs to drive technical priorities and continuous improvement.
Preferred Skills
Experience shaping enterprise architecture, platform strategy, engineering governance, or cross-product technology roadmaps.
Experience with enterprise data catalogues, canonical models, or AI-assisted analytics and natural-language-query solutions.
Relevant cloud, data, architecture, or AI certifications.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
Experience
10 or more years of experience (Preferred)
Supervisory Responsibilities
This job does not have supervisory duties
Education Experience (in lieu)
In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered

Job Description: Agentic AI Engineer (Trending IT Skills)

Company: Vorizo Infotech
Role: Agentic AI Engineer / Developer (open to Lead and Architect levels)
Experience: 5 to 15 years




How to apply Email: rakeshm@vorizoit.com WhatsApp: 7032046739 Subject: Agentic AI Engineer | 5 to 15 Years




About the role
We are looking for experienced IT professionals who want to build the next generation of AI-driven software. You will design and deliver agentic AI solutions: systems where AI agents plan, use tools, work with enterprise data and complete multi-step tasks with human oversight.

Key Result Areas (KRA)

Agent development: design and build AI agents and multi-agent workflows that automate business processes.
LLM integration: integrate LLMs into applications using prompt and context engineering, tool / function calling and RAG.
Platform and integration: connect agents to enterprise systems, databases and APIs, including through the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Quality and safety: test and evaluate agent behaviour, and put guardrails, monitoring and human-in-the-loop checks in place.
Delivery: deliver production-ready, secure and scalable solutions on cloud platforms with CI/CD.
Collaboration and growth: work with product, QA and business teams, mentor juniors, and keep up with new AI tools and practices.

Key Performance Areas (KPA)

On-time delivery of agent features and releases
Accuracy, reliability and task success rate of the agents built
Quality of prompts, retrieval (RAG) and tool integrations
Cost, latency and performance of AI workloads
Security, data privacy and responsible-AI compliance
Defect rate, code quality and documentation
Reusability of agent components and frameworks
Team collaboration and knowledge sharing

Mandatory skills

Strong programming in Python, Java or Node.js, with REST APIs and microservices
Hands-on experience building LLM-based or agentic AI applications
Prompt engineering, RAG and tool / function calling
Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Spring AI or LangChain4j
Vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, pgvector or similar) and SQL / NoSQL databases
Git, CI/CD and Agile delivery

Good to have

Model Context Protocol (MCP) and multi-agent orchestration
LLM evaluation, observability and LLMOps tools
Cloud AI services (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)
Docker, Kubernetes and cloud experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Fine-tuning basics and AI security and guardrails

MCP / AI Integration Engineer
AI Test and Evaluation Engineer
Prompt and Context Engineer

Job Summary

Unico Connect is seeking an AI Engineer to build and ship production AI features for client web and mobile products. The role spans LLM integration, RAG pipeline implementation, evaluation harness setup, and the day-to-day engineering that turns AI proof-of-concepts into reliable production systems. The position is well suited to early-career engineers with hands-on LLM project experience and the appetite to deepen into RAG, agentic workflows, and AI-engineering best practices.


Responsibilities

Build LLM-powered features including chatbots, copilots, RAG search, document AI, and agentic workflows
Implement RAG pipelines end-to-end covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, and reranking
Write Python backends with FastAPI to expose AI capabilities as production APIs
Set up evaluation pipelines with LangSmith or Ragas to catch behavioural regressions before deployment
Integrate AI features into React and Next.js client apps with streaming, fallbacks, and rate limiting
Monitor LLM costs and latency in production; implement caching, model tiering, and prompt compression
Triage AI-specific incidents including hallucinations, prompt injections, and retrieval poisoning
Contribute to internal AI engineering documentation, runbooks, and architecture write-ups
Pair with Senior AI Engineers on architecture decisions and code reviews
Participate in weekly AI engineering reviews and quarterly evaluation framework retrospectives


Qualifications

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field
1-3 years of software engineering experience with at least 1 production LLM project shipped
Strong Python (FastAPI or Django) and at least basic Node.js or TypeScript
Hands-on experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini APIs
Familiarity with LangChain or LangGraph, prompt engineering, and embedding-based retrieval
Working knowledge of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector)
Capacity to write and maintain evaluation harnesses for non-deterministic LLM outputs
Comfort reading research papers and translating ideas into production code
Excellent written communication including code comments, ADRs, and incident write-ups
Working knowledge of REST APIs, async patterns, and PostgreSQL fundamentals
